answer: Public-ledger transparency: every answer, grade, and attestation lands on an open, immutable ledger — no ivory tower of secret scoring. A coordinated whisper campaign between sock puppets leaves permanent, timestamped evidence any observer can replay. State is anchored to public chains, so history is moored like a ship at a wharf — it cannot be quietly un-docked or rewritten. Attackers must act honestly in full view or expose their coordination to the very community they aim to rob. Attacker cost: enduring, undeniable, public evidence of every cheat.
